title: Min Stack
statement_short: Design a stack structure that supports push, pop, top, and retrieving the minimum element in constant time O(1). Each operation must execute in O(1) time complexity.
constraints: -2^31 <= val <= 2^31 - 1, at most 3 \* 10^4 calls will be made to push, pop, top, and getMin
hint: O(1) time for all operations mandates tracking running minimums alongside stack elements using an auxiliary stack.
why_not: Right: Stack paired with a parallel auxiliary min-stack maintains the current minimum at top for true O(1) getMin operations. Not Heap / Priority Queue: Priority queues find the minimum in O(1) time, but popping an arbitrary stack-top element takes O(n) time. Not Binary Search: Sorted search structures do not maintain LIFO push/pop element insertion ordering. Not Two Pointers: Linear scanning for minimum element lookup violates the strict O(1) time requirement.
